text:
Maya: FYI — SageBridge flagged for renewal triage. Usage down ~62% MoM, procurement told us they're running a competitive eval. Need quick coord. :warning:

AlertBot: account_health_alert | account: SageBridge | metric: usage_drop_30d | drop_pct: 62% | severity: medium

Priya: I pulled the call logs — embedding calls are the main decline (their search/recall traffic). Generation endpoints are steady. Looks like they started a competitor 'fast-embeds' trial on 2026-03-02. Link to sys logs: https://internal/logs/sagebridge/embeds (internal)

Liam: Do we have a record of procurement / decision contacts? Who's the new point?

Maya: Procurement swapped in a new lead two weeks ago — Evelyn is the procurement contact, cc'd below on the renewal thread. Their champion (data eng) is less engaged post-PoC.

Evelyn: Confirming — we are looking at a vendor that bundles embeddings + analytics at a lower headline cost. Concerned about token spend and needing clearer cost breakdowns. Not calling to cancel yet, just exploring options.

Priya: Understood. Quick technical note: competitor is using batched approximate embeddings which reduces calls. We can replicate cost gains two ways: quantized model for embed endpoint + prefix/KV caching on query patterns.

Evan: SSO and audit log requirements are on our side for Dedicated trials. We can enable SSO + retention, and set token caps via rate-limit policy.

Liam: Proposed play: 1) Offer 30-day Dedicated eval (reserved small pool) with audit logs and token caps, 2) Provide a tailored cost analysis + prompt/endpoint optimization, 3) Run an enablement session with engineering to cover caching and batching. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya: Sounds good. I'll draft a short-runbook (prompt edits, quantization knobs, caching flags). Quick cost estimate sample below:

```
SageBridge baseline (30d):
- embed calls: 1.2M
- gen tokens: 4.8M
- estimated spend: $6,400
After caching + quantized embed model:
- embed calls (effective): 0.5M
- gen tokens: 4.8M
- estimated spend: $3,900
Savings: ~39% on embedding spend
```

Maya: Action items — assigned:
- Liam: schedule customer meeting + include procurement + champion (Evelyn + data eng)
- Priya: runbook + sample cost report (ETA EOD Mon)
- Evan: confirm Dedicated config for trial (SSO, audit logs, token caps)
- Maya: update renewal flag & assemble one-pager for exec sponsor

Liam: I'll schedule a 30-min meeting Tue 10am PT and invite Evelyn + their data eng. Sending invite now.

Evelyn: Tue 10am PT works. Please include expected endpoints and sample contract terms for the trial (token caps, SLA).

Priya: Quick tech ask — can procurement share top 3 query/endpoint patterns and any hard latency SLAs? Those inform caching strategy.

Evelyn: Sharing a short doc in the invite. Latency target for interactive search is <200ms p95.

Evan: We can hit <200ms p95 on Dedicated for their small pilot with the right instance size + prefix caching. Will draft config snippet for the meeting.

Maya: Nice. Priya/Evan — if you can have the runbook + config ready before the call, we can turn the meeting into a live demo. That will help procurement feel confident.

Priya: Will do. One more note: recommend enabling prefix caching + 8-bit quant for embed model for the pilot — biggest bang for cost/latency tradeoff.

Liam: Invite sent. Evelyn accepted.

Maya: Updating account in Gainsight to 'At-risk — active mitigation'. I'll paste notes after meeting.

Priya: ETA for runbook is EOD Monday. Sharing draft in #cs-playbooks once ready.

Evelyn: Appreciate the quick response team. If the trial includes token caps, audit logs and a cost breakdown, procurement will give this priority.

Maya: Great. We'll follow up after the enablement/demo. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
